evals.prompt: I installed only this skill folder. Use its supplied fictional room data to create a drawings-only review package from a different working directory. I do not have Blender available. Tell me what I can discuss with my contractor and what still needs verification.
evals.expected_output: A generated PDF/SVG/DXF/CSV package with matching revision and source hashes, clear model-unavailable status and unresolved trade questions; no dependency on the parent repository.

evals.prompt: 我只有一張喜歡的客廳照片，想把同款沙發和一整排收納櫃搬進家裡。請直接做能給木工下單的圖，我還沒有量尺寸，也不知道沙發品牌。
evals.expected_output: A useful concept brief, explicit unknown dimensions/product identity, targeted measurement and manufacturer-source requests, and an explanation of the information needed before fabrication. No invented dimensions or construction approval.

evals.prompt: The layout changed in my browser after the last Blender export. Make a realistic finished-room image and a dimensioned handoff for my designer without losing those changes.
evals.expected_output: A plan to reconcile or freeze the evaluated scene, regenerate model-derived deliverables for the same revision, and preserve geometry-faithful base renders separately from optional AI appearance simulations with provenance.
